name: Turing.captureCfg_state
printed_header:
Turing.captureCfg_state.{u_1, u_2} {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
  (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Turing.Cfg k Bool S input) :
  (Turing.captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).state = some ((Option.map emb c.state).getD ret)

name: Turing.captureCfg_inputPos
printed_header:

name: Turing.captureCfg_workTapes
printed_header:
Turing.captureCfg_workTapes.{u_1, u_2} {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
  (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Turing.Cfg k Bool S input) (i : Fin (k + 1)) (a✝ : ℤ) :
  (Turing.captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).workTapes i a✝ =
    (if h : ↑i < k then c.workTapes ⟨↑i, h⟩ else Turing.FinTM.bufferTape (pre ++ c.output)) a✝

name: Turing.captureCfg_workTapePos
printed_header:
Turing.captureCfg_workTapePos.{u_1, u_2} {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H)
  (ret : H) (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Turing.Cfg k Bool S input) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
  (Turing.captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).workTapePos i =
    if h : ↑i < k then c.workTapePos ⟨↑i, h⟩ else ↑(pre ++ c.output).length

name: Turing.captureCfg_output
printed_header:
Turing.captureCfg_output.{u_1, u_2} {k : ℕ} {S : Type u_1} {H : Type u_2} {input : List Bool} (emb : S → H) (ret : H)
  (pre out₀ : List Bool) (c : Turing.Cfg k Bool S input) : (Turing.captureCfg emb ret pre out₀ c).output = out₀
